issues.evidence: The text says only "desire to be free from the state/place of beings"; "suffering" is not stated.
issues.fix: 想要脫離眾生所在的地方，就要好好守護這顆珍貴的覺悟之心。

issues.evidence: The giving of food and drink is continuous ("持續供應飲食"); the children's text drops the continuous provision and only says "a little food".
issues.fix: 如果有人一直給少數眾生一點飲食，卻只在短短的時間裡給一頓飯，還帶著輕視，只讓人飽上半天，世人還是會尊敬他做了好事。

issues.span: 如果有人只給少數眾生一點食物。他只花短短的時間給一頓飯。就算他帶著輕視
issues.evidence: The conditional is broken into separate sentences by full stops, leaving "如果...。" and "就算..." ungrammatical.
issues.fix: 如果有人給少數眾生一點食物，只花短短的時間給一頓飯，還帶著輕視，只讓人飽上半天，世人還是會尊敬他做了好事。

issues.span: 想要獲得累積的福氣的智慧
issues.evidence: The Tibetan/academic text speaks of the wisdom/intelligence that cultivates merit ("修福德之慧"), not wanting to obtain it; wording is also tangled.
issues.fix: 世界上想要去累積福氣的智慧，在一百次裡偶爾才會出現一次。

issues.span: 就隨便他們對我做吧 / 只要有人遇到我、想到我
issues.evidence: Academic: "whatever action does not harm them, let them do it; in relation to me, may none be in vain". "Do to me" and "meet me, think of me / get benefit" are not stated.
issues.fix: 只要是不會傷害到他們自己的事，就讓他們去做吧。希望不管在什麼時候，只要和我有關，就不會有人白費力氣。

issues.span: 如果嚴重的墮落，和強大的覺悟之心，在輪迴中交替出現。我就要花很久
issues.evidence: The "if" clause is cut off by a full stop from its main clause, which is ungrammatical.
issues.fix: 如果嚴重的墮落，和強大的覺悟之心，在輪迴中交替出現，我就要花很久的時間，才能走到菩薩修行的更高階段。

issues.evidence: Academic: respect arises "out of fear" (畏懼); "敬畏" (awe/reverence) shifts the sense.
issues.fix: 如果有緣的人因為心裡害怕而生起恭敬，仔細留意就能很輕鬆地生起。

issues.span: 當我聽到各種無聊的話語，或是看到許多新奇的景象。如果我參與其中
issues.evidence: The "when" clause is split from its main clause by a full stop; "聽到/看到" then "參與其中" is redundant and ungrammatical.
issues.fix: 當我參與各種無聊的話語，或是許多新奇的景象時，要放下對它們的緊抓不放。

issues.span: 下輩子更會帶來巨大的痛苦
issues.evidence: Academic: "in the next life there is also great suffering" (亦有大苦); "更" (even more) adds a comparison that is not there.
issues.fix: 下輩子也會帶來巨大的痛苦。

issues.evidence: Academic says the action is prompted "always" (恆) by strong intention; the children's text drops "always".
issues.fix: 如果是一直帶著強烈的心意去做，或是靠解藥的力量去做。

issues.span: 隔天一早就要馬上起床
issues.evidence: Academic: set firmly in the mind from the start the intention of rising quickly; "next morning" and "before sleep" timing are not stated.
issues.fix: 要保持警覺，一開始就在心裡下定決心：要趕快起床。
